heading: Load
text:
### Load [IRET.18.2]

The artefact loader (`dsc/rete_loader.c`) decodes the `AlphaNode` /
`BetaNode` / `TerminalNode` atom bodies (IRET.16), and `ds_rete_load_network`
builds the in-memory node graph from them. Steps, in order:

1. Decode each `AlphaNode` / `BetaNode` / `TerminalNode` atom body via the
   chosen protobuf library (IRET.23.6). Return
   `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE` on decode failure, before any other check of the body
   ([RDSC.11.4]).
2. Validate all `node_id` cross-references resolve before
   constructing any pointer (IRET.16.8). Return
   `DS_ERR_RETP_INDEX_OOB` on first violation.
3. Schemas are **already registered** — the SCHEMA atom
   family (`SchemaTtl`/`SchemaLogical`/`Slot`/`SchemaDef`/`SchemaSource`) loads and
   registers into the rete schema reg (`dsc_register_rete_schemas`)
   *before* the network atoms.
4. Construct alpha nodes from the `AlphaNode` atoms —
   compile regex test patterns (IRET.6.3); wire into the
   schema's alpha-dispatch entry.
5. Construct beta nodes from the `BetaNode` atoms —
   allocate join-test expression trees recursively; set
   `is_negative`; wire left-parent and right-alpha links by
   `node_id`.
6. Construct terminal nodes from the `TerminalNode` atoms —
   allocate RHS action expression trees.
7. Wire all downstream links (beta children, terminal
   children, beta inputs on alpha nodes) using the `node_id`
   references encoded in the atoms.

If any step fails, the load returns the error and sets the halt latch: a
failed load spends the engine ([RDSC.9.8]). The loader undoes nothing it
applied. There is no reload: an engine loads one artefact for its life
([RARC.10.1]).

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__load
idris.note: LOAD: alphas from their schemas and tests, chains from their nodes and actions, every memory empty, then every root seeded [RDSC.4a.5]. Cross-reference validation and expression construction are out of scope.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__load_view
idris.note: THE LOADED NETWORK HAS THE VIEW: empty working memory, empty memories, and every chain the nil token's wave.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__load_ordered
idris.note: THE LOADED NETWORK IS ORDERED: empty working memory, empty memories, and every terminal the nil token's activation or nothing.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__init_agree
idris.note: The loaded engine agrees with FireLoop's empty state under the program it lowers to.
